description: Zero-dependency hybrid search engine combining BM25 whole-token matching with character n-gram fuzzy matching. Configurable field weights, synonym expansion, and exact-match boosting. Index any collection of documents and query with typo tolerance.

library_notes.general: Single responsibility — one widget does one thing. No global state. No project-specific code, hardcoded paths, credentials, or environment-specific values. All dependencies must be declared in widget.json tech_stack.dependencies. Do not modify library_notes — it is managed by Cartograph and will be restored on checkin.
library_notes.language: Use pytest for all tests — no unittest. Type hints required on all public functions. No __init__.py in tests/. No if __name__ == '__main__' blocks in src/ files. Imports ordered: stdlib, third-party, local.
